title: Aquatic SMP Essentials
description: a pack to make your aquatic smp experience way better
body:
**Aquatic SMP** Essentials is an overlay texture pack packed with useful features designed specifically for the Aquatic SMP!
1. **Combat Visibility**
1. **Small shield**
1. **Small totem and compact pop animation**
1. **Small utility models (Food, Pearls, etc.)**
1. **No pumpkin screen overlay**
1. **Performance & Particle Optimization**
1. **Low fire and no smoke on fire**
1. **No block-breaking particles**
1. **No explosion particles**
1. **Reduced normal and critical hit particles**
1. **Environmental** 
1. **Clear water and no fog**
1. **Full bright and brighter nether**
1. **Unobtrusive rain and snow**
1. **Quiet explosions and no cave sounds**
- This pack enhances your performance in crystal PvP and general Minecraft gameplay. Features like small pops and compact utility items provide maximum visibility during intense combat. Meanwhile, clear water and full bright settings make everyday survival much cleaner.DISCLAIMER: This texture pack is made for the **Aquatic SMP** Minecraft server. I am not affiliated with the Aquatic SMP in any way, and this is not an official Aquatic SMP product.
